text: EXT. SCHOOL GATE - DAY1 1

A sleek, bright red convertible SPEEDS into view, drawing the attention of bystanders. The car SCREECHES to a stop. GRAY, dressed in stylish casual wear, LEAPS out of the driver’s seat without opening the door. He swings around to the back, pulling out a bouquet of lilies. His face beams with excitement as he rushes to the passenger side and GENTLY OPENS the door. ALICE steps out gracefully, dressed in an elegant old-money ensemble. She casually removes her sunglasses, her expression poised and confident. Gray hands her the bouquet and pulls her into a tight hug. GRAY(excited)Sis, don’t forget! You have to meet my girlfriend, Ashley at the alumni charity gala. Alice tilts her head, teasing him. ALICE(amused)I know! You mentioned it so many times on the way here, it's obvious you’re into her. GRAY(grinning, thrilled)Of course! She’s the most perfect, kind-hearted woman I’ve ever met! ALICE(smiling playfully)Then I’m really looking forward to meeting her. Alright, see you later! CLOSE-UP: Gray and Alice exchange a cheek kiss before parting. Hiding behind a flowerbed nearby, NICOLE watches in shock, covering her mouth.

NICOLE(whispering, to herself) ！ ，Holy carp Wait……That's Gray ！Asley's boy friend Nicole quickly pulls out her phone, adjusts the angle carefully, and RAPIDLY SNAPS multiple photos. She immediately sends them to an Instagram group chat. NICOLE(cont'd)(typing)Ashley, there’s a woman getting really cozy with Gray at the school gate! Could he be cheating on you?!
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY2 2

The VIP lounge is under renovation, with workers finishing up an oil painting restoration. Ashley, surrounded by Nicole and her FOLLOWER 1 and 2, flaunts her Swan family crest badge. ASHLEY(bragging)I heard Gray is planning to propose to me. After tonight, I’ll officially be the fiancée of the Swan family’s second heir! Her minions gaze at her with admiration, their eyes fixed on the emblem. FOLLOWER 1(grinning)Gray is rich and handsome. Ashley, congrats on securing a lifetime meal ticket! ASHLEY(smugly)I also heard Gray has a very powerful sister. I need to find a way to win her over. That way, once I marry Gray, I’ll get Swan Group shares too. FOLLOWER 2(encouraging)You’ve got this! Ashley basks in their admiration—until her phone VIBRATES. She glances at the screen, reading Nicole’s message. Her expression IMMEDIATELY DARKENS.

ASHLEY(outraged)Who the hell is this woman?! CLOSE-UP: Ashley enlarges the photo—Gray and Alice cheek-to-cheek. Follower 1 peeks over her shoulder. ASHLEY(cont'd)(seething)That BITCH actually dares to flirt with Gray on MY turf?! FOLLOWER 1(smirking)Everyone knows Gray is yours. This is a direct challenge. FOLLOWER 2(egging her on)If she steals him, you’ll lose your ticket to the Swan fortune. You’d better put her in her place! Alice enters at that moment. Ashley spots her and IMMEDIATELY STORMS FORWARD, her fake smile vanishing. Ashley’s eyes land on a nearby bucket of red paint, left by the workers. She PICKS IT UP. In one swift motion, she SLAPS Alice across the face before DUMPING the red paint over her. CLOSE-UP: The bouquet of lilies Gray gifted Alice—now drenched in red paint. Alice stares at Ashley in disbelief, as if looking at a lunatic.
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY3 3
Ashley glares at Alice, her fury exploding. ASHLEY(venomous)You slut! How dare you seduce my boyfriend?!

Alice, her face still smeared with paint, retaliates with a HARD SLAP. ALICE(coldly)What the hell are you talking about? Ashley clutches her face, her cheek now imprinted with a vivid paint-covered hand print. She looks FURIOUS. ASHLEY(enraged)You hit me?! You actually hit me! Ashley signals NICOLE, who immediately pulls out her phone, enlarging the picture. CLOSE-UP: Gray giving Alice flowers, their body language intimate. NICOLE(accusingly)OMG, you're totally a home-wrecking whore! ALICE(scoffing)If I’m the homewrecker, what does that make you? Nicole JABS a finger at Ashley’s chest, where the Swan family crest badge. NICOLE(proudly)Look at this crest. Look! Ashley is Gray’s official girlfriend! The future fiancée of Swan Group’s heir! And I’m her best friend. Nicole steps closer, her voice dripping with malice. NICOLE(cont'd)(taunting)I suggest you get on your knees and apologize to Ashley. Or else… Alice’s eyes shift to the emblem. ALICE(casual)So… you’re Gray’s girlfriend?

She lowers her head, seemingly in thought. ALICE (V.O.)She doesn’t seem as kind as Gray described. Looks like I'll need to keep a low-profile and observe. Alice looks up, locking eyes with Ashley. ALICE(evenly)Even if you are Gray’s girlfriend, that doesn’t give you the right to attack other people. Do you know who I am? ASHLEY(scoffs, arrogant)It doesn’t matter who you are. This is my territory, and I make the rules here! Alice raises an eyebrow. ALICE(amused)Are you sure you want to talk to me like that? Ashley starts SHOVING Alice, her voice dripping with contempt. ASHLEY(mocking)You actually think you can threaten me?! Let me make this clear—Gray is MINE! Stay away from him! Alice crosses her arms. ALICE(smirks)Oh? You’re lecturing me now? You do realize that without me, he’d be nothing.
FOLLOWER 1(snickering)Oh my god, are you saying Gray owes everything to YOU? Who the hell do you think you are?!
Alice pulls out her phone, dialing Gray’s number. ALICE(firmly)I’m calling Gray. And you’ll find out exactly who I am.
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY5 5

Alice stands, phone in hand. The atmosphere in the room shifts—everyone is struck by her commanding presence. Ashley grows visibly tense. FOLLOWER 1(whispering)Is she really someone important? FOLLOWER 2(suspicious)Could she be from the Swan family? ASHLEY(snapping, trying to dismiss them)Don’t scare yourselves. There’s no such person in the Swan family! Gray only has one sister. She’s the genius investor who made Swan Group New York’s top rising empire. NICOLE(realization dawning)Wait… No way! Could she actually be Gray’s sister? ASHLEY(panicking, forcing composure)Impossible! Gray told me himself that his sister is overseas at an investor summit! Everyone watches Alice. Gray’s phone remains unanswered. Alice lowers her phone. Ashley exhales in relief, her arrogance returning. FOLLOWER 1(mocking)Well, well, look who just embarrassed herself!

Gray didn’t pick up? Hah! Now, tell us... who exactly are you? NICOLE(condescending)Just because you slept with Gray doesn’t make you important. Ashley steps closer, running her fingers across Alice’s face before giving her a humiliating pat. ASHLEY(gritting her teeth)You really have the face of a cheap little tramp. Alice SLAPS Ashley across the face, knocking her hand away. ALICE(coldly)Now you’ve really pissed me off, Ashley. ASHLEY(stunned, then furious, raising her hand to strike back)So what?! What can you do to me? Alice GRABS Ashley’s wrist, squeezing tightly before shoving it away. ALICE(low, firm)You will never enter the Swan family because I will never let you marry Gray. ASHLEY(scoffs)And what power do you have to stop me? Alice methodically dusts off her fingers, completely unbothered. ALICE(smug)I am all the power that it takes. ASHLEY(fuming)Oh really? How so?

ALICE(tilts her chin, composed)I’m Gray’s sister. The rightful heir to Swan Group. And I do not approve of this marriage. Ashley and her followers freeze. Then, Ashley suddenly BURSTS into LAUGHTER. Nicole follows. The others CHUCKLE. ASHLEY(mocking, looking Alice up and down)You? Gray’s sister? NICOLE(laughing)Even I know Gray’s sister is not in the country. You really think you can impersonate her? Ashley waves her hand—her minions GRAB Alice’s arms. Ashley YANKS a fistful of Alice’s hair. ALICE(eyes burning, deliberate)You’ll find out soon enough. Alice struggles. Ashley smirks and gestures to her lackeys. NICOLE(snide)You think you can scare us? You’ll totally pay for this. The girls move in to strip Alice’s clothes. Ashley watches with a twisted grin, as the SHRILL LAUGHTER of her lackeys ECHOES in Alice’s ears. Alice desperately shields herself.
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY6 6

Alice struggles violently. ALICE(struggling, furious)Let me go! If you want proof I’m Gray’s sister, just call him and ask! Ashley raises her heel and SLAMS it down onto Alice’s hand. ALICE SCREAMS in pain.

ASHLEY(smirking)No need. I know what he'll say, so you'd better disappear forever. ALICE(wincing, seething)Ashley, you will regret this. NICOLE(mocking)Look at her...still making threats. FOLLOWER 1(smirks)Still acting like she’s someone important. You really think we’re stupid enough to believe you’re Gray’s sister? ALICE(defiant)I am. ASHLEYYou still don’t get it... Since she’s dreaming, let’s wake you up the hard way. Ashley crouches down and YANKS off Alice’s coat. ASHLEY(cont'd)(grinning maliciously)I’ll ruin your face, record your humiliation, and show Gray what a pathetic mess you really are. You’ll regret ever touching my man. Alice is left in just a camisole, her arms crossed tightly over her chest. Ashley pulls out her phone and hits RECORD. ASHLEY(cont'd)(laughing)Come on, let’s give everyone a show. Let’s see what you’ve got to offer. Alice thrashes, but the minions HOLD HER DOWN, too strong to fight off.

ALICE(low, deadly)You'll regret this. ASHLEY(chuckles, amused)Regret? You should be begging me right now. The girls FORCE Alice onto the ground, her cheek pressed against Ashley’s shoe. Ashley grabs a nearby PEN. She twirls it once before suddenly STABBING it down—aiming for Alice’s face. The PEN STABS into the WOOD FLOOR—barely an inch from Alice’s cheek. CLOSE-UP: Alice’s desperate, helpless expression. Suddenly, Gray’s assistant, JASON, BURSTS into the room. His eyes widen at the horrific scene before him. JASON(shouting, horrified)WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING?! STOP RIGHT NOW!
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY7 7

The minions GASP, startled, and quickly release Alice. Jason steps forward, his face darkening in shock as he sees Alice on the floor. JASON(stunned, furious)You… you actually did this to her? Ashley’s eyes immediately LOCK onto Jason. In an instant, her demeanor shifts from domineering to pitiful. ASHLEY(snarling at her followers)How could you?! Who gave you permission to bully her like this?! Ashley crouches down, pretending to help Alice up.

ASHLEY(cont'd)(softly, full of fake concern)Are you hurt? This all must be a misunderstanding. Alice winces, her brows furrowing. She SLAPS Ashley’s hand away. ALICE (V.O.)Unbelievable. She’s so shameless! What a good actor. If I don’t expose her in front of Gray, she’ll just keep lying her way out of everything. Jason quickly approaches, instinctively about to call “Alice”, but Alice subtly SHAKES HER HEAD, stopping him. JASON(slight hesitation, then politely)...Miss, what happened here? Ashley turns to Jason, her voice trembling, eyes filled with fake distress. ASHLEY(almost sobbing)It’s my fault… My friend Nicole thought this lady was being mean to me and lost her temper. I tried to stop her, but— Ashley lowers her head, fingers lightly brushing her cheek as if reliving a terrible memory. ASHLEY(cont'd)(sighing dramatically)I tried my best to stop it, but she still got hurt… God, I feel so guilty. I don’t think I’ll be able to sleep tonight. Alice’s eyes widen. She lets out a SHARP LAUGH, utterly incredulous. ALICE(scoffing)Wow. You’re actually rewriting reality? Go on, then. Tell me—how exactly did I bully you?

Ashley’s fake sorrow vanishes instantly. Her face darkens as she suddenly steps forward, blocking Jason’s view. She reaches out as if to fix Alice’s hair—but instead, she GRIPS a handful and YANKS it hard. ASHLEY(low, cold, venomous)Jason is here. If you dare say a word, you’re dead. Alice doesn’t hesitate. She lifts her hand— ALICE(casually, with a smirk)You said I bullied you? Was it like this? SLAP! Ashley’s head SNAPS to the side, eyes wide in shock. Ashley clutches her stinging cheek, her expression twisting in rage. ASHLEY(snarling)You bitch— Alice tilts her head innocently. ALICE(sweetly)Oh, I see. That wasn’t enough? Then how about this.
Ashley’s face whips in the opposite direction. The entire room falls SILENT. Alice smiles, tilting her head as if considering something. ALICE(cont'd)(smirking)Or was it more like that?

Ashley SHRIEKS in rage, lunging for Alice — Alice SHOVES HER HARD. Ashley stumbles back, losing her balance. She FALLS onto the floor, humiliated. Alice steps forward, planting her foot firmly on Ashley’s hand, keeping her pinned. ASHLEY(screaming, struggling)You—!

Alice kneels slightly, grabbing Ashley’s chin, forcing her to look up. ALICE(voice icy, eyes narrowing)You're dreaming if you think you'll get my forgiveness. Her gaze flickers to a nearby paint bucket. Alice smirks. She REACHES OUT, tipping the bucket over— A WAVE OF THICK, RED PAINT CRASHES DOWN onto Ashley. Ashley’s expression morphs into horror as the paint DRENCHES her from head to toe. Her SCREAM echoes through the room. Alice watches coolly. ALICE(cont'd)(mocking, wiping her hands)Don’t look at me like that. I’m just giving you exactly what you asked for. Ashley trembles with rage, drenched in paint, her face a picture of humiliation.
INT. ALUMNI ROOM - VIP LOUNGE - DAY8 8

Ashley, covered in red paint, looks utterly disheveled. She presses her hands against the floor, struggling to get up, her fists clenching so tightly that her knuckles turn white. Nicole rushes to Ashley’s side, helping her up. She then glares at Alice, rolling up her sleeves, ready to charge. NICOLE(screeching)This bitch is too arrogant! I’m going to teach her a lesson! Ashley grabs Nicole’s arm, stopping her. ASHLEY(gritting her teeth, voice low)Jason is here. Stay calm. Don’t mess things up.

Alice stands with her arms crossed, looking down at Ashley, amused. ALICE (V.O.)This woman will endure anything just to marry into a wealthy family. If she can tolerate this, she must be truly shameless. I’ll give her a little warning for now, but I must expose her true face to Gray. Alice smirks, her eyes filled with mockery. ALICE(smirking)I’ll let you go this time, for Gray’s sake. But you’d better watch your mouth and stop creating trouble. Alice glances at Jason, who quickly understands his cue. He composes himself, then steps forward with a polite smile. JASON(gently, smiling)Ladies, since this was just a misunderstanding, let’s talk things out peacefully. There’s no need to escalate the situation. (beat) Wait a second. Jason turns around, walks to the table and grabs the an exquisite box. He comes back toward Ashley, holding it with both hands. He bows slightly as he presents it to her. JASON(cont'd)(respectfully)Miss Ashley, Young Master Gray asked me to deliver this to you. He said you would need it later. Ashley immediately straightens up and accepts the box. She quickly opens it and sees an antique blue and white porcelain vase. A flicker of satisfaction crosses her eyes. ASHLEY(sweetly, her voice dripping with affection)Thank you. Gray is always so thoughtful.

Alice furrows her brows slightly, a hint of disapproval flashing across her face. She shakes her head in silent frustration. ALICE (V.O.)Gray, you idiot. How could you give her something so valuable? You’re completely love blind. JASONLadies, have a nice day! Ashley watches Jason leave, her expression quickly turning cold. She suddenly raises her hand, aiming to slap Alice. Alice reacts instantly, grabbing Ashley’s wrist firmly before the slap can land. ALICE(calmly, with a hint of warning)As soon as Jason leaves you reveal your true colors. You might want to think twice—he’s still nearby. Ashley grits her teeth, her face flushed with anger. She yanks her hand away, her breath heavy with suppressed rage. ASHLEY(low, furious)You’ll pay for this. Alice meets her glare head-on, unfazed. ALICE(smirking slightly)I’ll be waiting. Ashley, momentarily unsettled by Alice’s piercing gaze, quickly regains her composure. Crossing her arms, she turns on her heel and strides away with her followers. As she passes Alice, she deliberately shoulder-checks her, making sure to leave a final act of defiance.
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY9 9
The grand banquet hall is lavishly decorated. Well-dressed GUESTS mingle, LAUGHTER and CHATTER filling the space. Champagne glasses clink elegantly.

CLOSE-UP: A large banner reading “Charity Donation Gala” hangs on the wall. Ashley, holding an exquisitely wrapped gift box, stands surrounded by Nicole and her followers. A smug smile lingers on her lips. Nicole leans in toward Ashley, her face filled with admiration. NICOLE(awed)Holy crap! Gray spent a fortune donating under your name. You’re definitely going to be the center of attention tonight. ASHLEY(arrogantly, playing with the ribbon on the box)You don’t understand. Gray told me his sister is passionate about charity. I’m just playing my cards right—makes it easier for me to marry into the family. The grand doors open slowly. Alice strides in, dressed in an elegant gown, exuding confidence. All eyes turn to her. The followers nudge Ashley as they notice Alice entering the room. FOLLOWER 2(pointing)Look! That gold-digger showed up too. Ashley turns, sneering at Alice. Laughter erupts among her group. They quickly stride over and surround Alice. ASHLEY(rolling her eyes)Showing up empty-handed at a charity gala? What, hoping to be some Cinderella who lands a rich husband? Have you looked in a mirror? Stop embarrassing yourself. NICOLE(mocking)Some women love using events like this to cozy up to powerful men. Nothing new.

Alice stands her ground, unfazed, her smile sharp. ALICE(firmly, countering)Everything I have, I earned—unlike some people who treat gold-digging as a skill and brag about it. Ashley’s face darkens at the remark, her tone turning sharp. ASHLEY(scoffing)Oh please. Who knows if anything you have is even real? Didn’t someone fake their identity before? The PRESIDENT of the alumni association steps onto the stage, microphone in hand. PRESIDENT (V.O.)Ladies and gentlemen, the charity donation event is now officially underway! First, let’s welcome Miss Ashley to the stage to present her donation. As Ashley passes by Alice, she deliberately lowers her voice and said: ASHLEYWatch closely. I’m the one who belongs by Gray’s side. Consider yourself lucky just to witness it. Ashley smirks, casting a condescending glance at Alice before confidently stepping onto the stage with the gift box. She hands the box to the PRESIDENT of the alumni association, who unveils it. PRESIDENT(politely, smiling)Oh my! A piece of blue and white porcelain from the East— an exquisite cultural relic! Thank you, Miss Ashley, for your generous donation. Ashley struts off the stage, her gaze locked onto Alice, exuding arrogance. PRESIDENT (V.O.)Now, let’s welcome Miss Alice to the stage.

Murmurs ripple through the crowd. Alice steps forward calmly, her expression unwavering. FOLLOWER 1 Slut! You didn’t bring anything—what are you donating? ALICE(smiling faintly)Who said I didn’t bring anything? Alice reaches up to the stage and slowly removes a necklace from around her neck. Under the lights, the necklace sparkles brilliantly. The PRESIDENT, suddenly freezes. His eyes widen in shock. In the blink of an eye, he rushes toward Alice with visible excitement. PRESIDENT(voice trembling, in disbelief)This… this is…!!! You—you’re…
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY10 10

The room buzzes with WHISPERS. GUEST 1(confused)What did she bring? Why is the president so excited? The PRESIDENT stands on stage, his gaze full of admiration as he carefully takes Alice’s donation in both hands. A server walks onto the stage carrying a necklace holder. The PRESIDENT carefully places the necklace on it, allowing it to rest gracefully. CLOSE-UP: The president lifts the holder, raising it high for everyone to see. PRESIDENT(voice booming with excitement)This is the Eye of Cyrus, a priceless royal treasure! It was said to have been in the Swan family’s collection for 25 years!

He walks toward Alice, his hands slightly raised in a gesture of deep appreciation. PRESIDENT(cont'd)(grateful)This… this is a legendary artifact! I never imagined I’d see it in my lifetime. Miss Alice, your donation is truly extraordinary. Before he can finish, Ashley suddenly storms onto the stage, snatching the microphone from the president. ASHLEY(scoffing)This is what your alumni association calls “prestigious”? Getting scammed by a gold-digger with a FAKE treasure? She turns to the PRESIDENT, her lips curling in contempt. ASHLEY(cont'd)(smirking)If you can’t even tell real from fake, maybe it’s time for you to retire. Alice stands tall, her gaze locked onto Ashley, a cold smirk forming at the corners of her lips. ALICE(mocking)Look at you-a “fake heiress” who needs your fiancé to donate in your ！name You have no right to judge priceless treasures! Ashley’s face FLUSHES RED. Her hands tremble with rage. Desperate, she YANKS the necklace from around her neck and holds it up high. ASHLEY(yelling)I DO have the right—because the REAL Eye of Cyrus is right here! And YOU’RE the fraud! Ashley shoots Alice a scornful look, rolling her eyes. ASHLEY(cont'd)(sneering)People like you should be grateful just to have a cheap knockoff.
Gasps ripple through the crowd. A wave of murmurs spreads across the hall. Alice’s eyes widen slightly. Her lips part in shock. ALICE(stunned, whispering to herself)How… how could she have that?
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY11 11

Ashley smirks, lifting her necklace high. ASHLEY(triumphant)Because my fiancé is Gray—the heir of the Swan family! She proudly displays the Eye of Cyrus in her hands. ASHLEY(cont'd)(loudly)Take a good look, everyone! The real Eye of Cyrus is in MY hands! She hands the necklace to the PRESIDENT. He takes it, his brows furrowing as he inspects it carefully. His eyes widen in visible shock. PRESIDENT(skeptical, voice raised)The Eye of Cyrus is a one-of-a-kind artifact… How can there be two identical pieces? The president put the necklace on another necklace holder which is carried by the server. Ashley folds her arms, chin lifted high, throwing a condescending glance at Alice. ASHLEY(smirking, acidic tone)Obviously, someone is using a fake. Isn’t that right, Alice? ALICE(chuckles coldly)Indeed. Ashley turns to the PRESIDENT.

ASHLEY(insistent)Go ahead, examine them. Tell everyone who the real fraud is. The president hesitates, his face full of concern. Ashley leans in, pressing him further. ASHLEY(cont'd)(pressuring)Look closely. I’m about to be engaged to Gray—I’m the fiancée of the Swan Group’s heir. The PRESIDENT exhales, spreading his hands apologetically. PRESIDENT(apologetic)I’m sorry… but I can’t verify their authenticity on the spot. Ashley scoffs, placing her hands on her hips. ASHLEY(mocking Alice)Oh, I see. You brought this so-called legendary treasure here because you knew no one could authenticate it! Ashley suddenly SNATCHES Alice’s necklace from the holder. ASHLEY(cont'd)(snarling)Let’s end this right now! Fake jewelry doesn’t belong here! CLOSE-UP: Alice’s eyes widen. The PRESIDENT looks horrified. Guests GASP, breath catching. PRESIDENT(panicked)Wait! That’s the Eye of Cyrus! ASHLEY(scoffing)Just a worthless fake. She lifts the necklace, preparing to SHATTER it. ASHLEY(cont'd)(confidently)I’m the fiancée of the Swan heir!

If I say it’s fake, who dares question me?! Alice’s sharp gaze narrows, her expression darkening. ALICE (V.O.)Why does she keep saying Gray is the heir? She doesn't understand that I’m the successor of the Swan family. GASP! Ashley swings to destroy the necklace. The PRESIDENT lunges forward, grabbing it tightly, stepping back in alarm. PRESIDENT(frantic)No, no, no! You can’t break it! What if you destroy the real one?! Swan Group's VP, Mr. Joe, is on his way. Once he arrives, he'll be able to tell which one is real. Ashley stiffens at his words. Her confident smirk FALTERS. ASHLEY (V.O.)What? Joe is coming? Alice smiles, amused. ALICE(softly, mocking)Oh? Mr. Joe is coming? He’s seen the real Eye of Cyrus. CLOSE-UP: Ashley’s fist clenches tightly. ALICE(cont'd)(teasing)What’s wrong? Getting nervous? Ashley takes a deep breath, forcing a smile. ASHLEY(faking calmness)Me? Nervous? I am Gray’s fiancée—the rightful owner of the Eye of Cyrus. Why would I be nervous? Alice raises a brow, smirking.

ALICE(smirking)Great. Then let’s wait for Joe and hear what he says. CLOSE-UP: Alice scans the crowd with a firm, unwavering gaze. ALICE(cont'd)(firmly)Once Joe arrives, you’ll all know exactly who I am.
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY12 12

The banquet hall doors slowly swing open. JOE strides in, his presence immediately drawing attention. His well-tailored suit highlights his refined, upright posture. His gentle smile radiates a dignified, approachable aura. A ASSISTANT follows beside him. Guests turn their heads, whispering among themselves. The PRESIDENT rushes forward to greet Joe, eagerly leading him to the stage. With careful hands, he lifts one of “the Eye of Cyrus” and presents it to Joe. PRESIDENT(respectful)Mr. Joe, this was donated tonight—a treasured artifact from the Swan family. Do you recognize it? Joe’s eyes widen slightly as he inspects the item. JOE(surprised)This is… the Eye of Cyrus?! PRESIDENT(nods, pointing to the other necklace)Yes! But… there are TWO identical pieces here tonight. CLOSE-UP: Alice and Ashley simultaneously turn toward Joe. ALICE (V.O.)Looks like this farce is about to end. Ashley smirks, flashing Alice a taunting glance.

ASHLEY(low, smirking)You think you’ve won? Ashley straightens her posture, flashing a charming smile at Joe. To her surprise, Joe meets her gaze and gives a polite nod in return. PRESIDENT(turning to Joe)Mr. Joe, these two pieces came from different donors. Could you help verify their authenticity? Joe examines both necklaces closely. His gaze lingers on Alice’s Eye of Cyrus, his eyes slightly widening. JOE (V.O.)This is Alice Swan’s necklace… Has she returned? Joe slowly lifts his head, shifting his focus from the necklace to the PRESIDENT. JOE(gently, hesitant)May I ask… who donated this piece? The PRESIDENT blinks, momentarily taken aback, then quickly scans the room before gesturing toward Alice. PRESIDENT(smiling)That young lady there. CLOSE-UP: Alice stands tall, meeting Joe's gaze head-on with unwavering confidence, her posture poised and composed. Joe hesitates, his voice carrying a note of uncertainty. JOE(softly, surprised)You…
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY13 13
Joe rotates the ring on his finger, his mind working rapidly. Suddenly, he stops, fixes his gaze on Alice, and studies her intently.

JOEWhere did you get your Eye of Cyrus? Alice looks back at him, surprised. ALICE (V.O.)He doesn’t recognize me? Makes sense. I’ve always communicated through my personal assistant with the Swan Group CEO and he’s only the Vice President. Alice lifts her chin, offering a confident smile. ALICEThis is a gift my dad gave me a long time ago. Ashley steps forward, crossing her arms, a smirk tugging at her lips. ASHLEY(mocking)Your father? Just now you were acting like Joe knew you, and now it’s a gift from your father? Let me guess—by ‘father,’ you mean your sugar daddy? A few people in the crowd CHUCKLE. Joe’s expression remains unreadable. He strides toward Ashley, bowing slightly. CLOSE-UP: Joe elegantly lifts Ashley’s hand and places a light kiss on the back of it, his thumb brushing over her palm. JOE(smoothly, warm tone)Miss Ashley, how lovely to see you again. Ashley’s eyes gleam with delight, her voice turning coy. ASHLEY(flirtatiously)Joe, you’re as charming as ever. GASPS ripple through the audience— GUEST 1Ashley and Joe know each other?

GUEST 2(grinning, fawning)Wow, Ashley is incredible. Even the Swan Group’s Vice President treats her with respect. Why is that gold-digger still standing here? Alice watches their interaction, her expression unreadable. ALICE (V.O.)Ashley and Joe look… very close. Something is definitely wrong here. I need to keep my identity hidden and uncover the truth.
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY14 14

Joe lets go of Ashley's hand. Ashley turns to Alice, smug. ASHLEY(adamant)Just admit it—you’re nothing but a desperate gold-digger. Your necklace is fake. Now get out. ALICE(firm)Let’s not jump to conclusions. Why don’t we let Joe authenticate it first? Joe looks at both necklaces, studying them carefully before putting on an air of authority. JOE(slowly)The Swan family does own this treasure. However, I can’t currently confirm its authenticity. But it is said that the real Eye of Cyrus glows in the dark. Joe’s lips curl into a smirk, his tone laced with condescension. JOE(cont'd)(pretending to be thoughtful)Why don’t we use this approach to test it later? Then we’ll know which is real.

Of course… maybe someone’s "sugar daddy" was tricked into buying a fake. Nicole, standing nearby, immediately laughs in delight. NICOLE(mocking)Can you believe Joe just called Alice’s necklace fake?! Ashley’s two followers jeer from the sidelines. One of them picks up a piece of fruit from a nearby table and hurls it toward Alice. FOLLOWER 1(shouting)Get lost, fraud! Alice catches the hateful stares but remains composed. She turns to the PRESIDENT and the guests. ALICE(calmly)We don’t need to wait. We can find a dark room and test the necklaces right now.
